scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: if [ "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir)" = "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" ]; then echo "The main checkout: nothing to set up, .env left as it is."; else ln -sf "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" .env && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec react-router typegen; fi
